t: Ben Felix · The 2.7% rule for retirement spending

mentions.x: For early retirees, Ben Felix has found the SWR to be closer to 2.7%. The oft-cited 4% depends on US data and studied 30-year time horizons. [video]
4% is specific to 60/40 US portfolio with 30 years horizon to not die poor at the end of it , a safer rate would be 2/2.5%[0] [0] [video]
…learning about the probability. * https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3689958 * [video] I'm Canadian, so I have a different home market, but that is correlated to the US economy…
